mapper.sql: create_time , update_time, bool_delete_enum, version, id, serial_number, project_id, project_settlement_type, supplier_price_id, product_type, manufacture_type, license_plate, driver_name, driver_phone, user_id, total_net_weight, total_groess_weight, actual_weight, actual_user_id, actual_time, audit_user_id, audit_time, status, send_time, receipt_name, receipt_phone, audit_receipt_name, audit_receipt_phone, receipt_time, price
mapper.select: SELECT project_id FROM tech_artifact tech_enclosure WHERE id =#{productId}

select c.*, c.create_time loadingTime, c.empty_cars, p.id 'project.id', p.name 'project.name', p.short_name 'project.short_name', p.serial_number 'project.serial_number', p.business_type 'project.business_type', s.`id` 'supplier.id', s.`name` 'supplier.name', c.`price` 'supplier.price', sp.`price_type` 'supplier.price_type', CASE c.structure_measure_mode WHEN 1 THEN c.total_net_weight ELSE c.actual_weight END mete from mes_enclosure_cargo_list c left join contract_project p on p.id = c.project_id left join mes_enclosure_supplier_price sp on sp.id = c.supplier_price_id left join scm_supplier s on s.id = sp.supplier_id
and c.bool_delete_enum = 0
and c.project_id = #{projectId}
AND (c.project_id in
#{projectId}
or c.project_id is null)
and c.price_type = #{priceType}
and c.supplier_price_id = #{supplierPriceId}
and c.manufacture_type = #{manufactureType}
and c.status & #{status} > 0
and c.serial_number like CONCAT('%',#{serialNumber},'%')
and s.`name` like CONCAT('%',#{supplierName},'%')
and c.license_plate like CONCAT('%',#{licensePlate},'%')
and c.product_type & #{productType} > 0
and c.category = #{category}
and c.delivery_status = #{deliveryStatus}
and c.shipment_status = #{shipmentStatus}
and date(c.status_update_date) >= date(#{statusUpdateStartDate})
and date(c.status_update_date) <= date(#{statusUpdateEndDate})
and date(c.actual_time) <= date(#{actualEndDate})
and c.driver_name like CONCAT('%',#{driverName},'%')
and c.user_name like CONCAT('%',#{userName},'%')
and date(c.create_time) >= date(#{startDate})
and date(c.create_time) <= date(#{endDate})
and c.actual_user_name like CONCAT('%',#{actualUserName},'%')
and date(c.actual_time) >= date(#{actualStartDate})
and date(c.actual_time) <= date(#{actualEndDate})
and c.audit_user_name like CONCAT('%',#{auditUserName},'%')
and date(c.audit_time) >= date(#{auditStartDate})
and date(c.audit_time) <= date(#{auditEndDate})
and c.receipt_name like CONCAT('%',#{receiptName},'%')
and c.audit_receipt_name like CONCAT('%',#{auditReceiptName},'%')
and date(c.audit_receipt_time) >= date(#{auditReceiptStartDate})
and date(c.audit_receipt_time) <= date(#{auditReceiptEndDate})
AND c.id IN
#{item}
order by c.create_time desc
select count(*) from mes_enclosure_cargo_list WHERE audit_time IS NOT NULL and project_id = #{projectId}

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(audit_time,'%Y-%m') month, COUNT(*) quantity FROM mes_enclosure_cargo_list WHERE status & 12 AND bool_delete_enum=0 AND DATE_FORMAT( audit_time, '%Y')=DATE_FORMAT( #{dateTime}, '%Y') AND shipment_status != ${@com.hzchum.scim.mes.enclosure.core.api.enums.cargoList.ShipmentStatusEnum@ABOLISH_DELIVERY.getType()} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(audit_time,'%Y-%m')

SELECT IFNULL( sum( cargo_link.quantity * artifact.net_weight ), 0 ) FROM mes_enclosure_cargo_list_product_link cargo_link LEFT JOIN tech_artifact artifact ON cargo_link.product_id = artifact.id LEFT JOIN mes_enclosure_cargo_list cargo ON cargo_link.cargo_list_id=cargo.id WHERE cargo_link.product_type = #{productType} AND cargo_link.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND cargo.`status` & 12 AND DATE_FORMAT(cargo.audit_time,'%Y' )= DATE_FORMAT(#{dateTime},'%Y')

SELECT IFNULL( sum( cargo_link.quantity * artifact.net_weight ), 0 ) FROM mes_enclosure_cargo_list_product_link cargo_link LEFT JOIN tech_artifact artifact ON cargo_link.product_id = artifact.id LEFT JOIN mes_enclosure_cargo_list cargo ON cargo_link.cargo_list_id=cargo.id WHERE cargo_link.product_type = #{productType} AND cargo_link.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND cargo.`status` & 12 AND date(cargo.audit_time)=date(#{dateTime})

SELECT ( a.sum - b.sum ) from ( SELECT IFNULL(sum(cargo.quantity * artifact.net_weight), 0) sum FROM mes_enclosure_warehouse_summary cargo LEFT JOIN tech_artifact artifact ON cargo.product_id = artifact.id WHERE cargo.product_type = #{productType} AND cargo.type = 1 AND cargo.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND date( cargo.create_time )<= date( #{dateTime})) a ,( SELECT IFNULL( sum( cargo.quantity * artifact.net_weight ), 0 ) sum FROM mes_enclosure_warehouse_summary cargo LEFT JOIN tech_artifact artifact ON cargo.product_id = artifact.id WHERE cargo.product_type = #{productType} AND cargo.type = 2 AND cargo.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND date ( cargo.create_time ) <= date ( #{dateTime})) b;

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(cargo.create_time, '%Y-%m') month, IFNULL(sum(cargo.quantity * artifact.net_weight), 0) amount FROM mes_enclosure_warehouse_summary cargo LEFT JOIN tech_artifact artifact ON cargo.product_id = artifact.id WHERE cargo.product_type = ${@com.hzchum.scim.mes.enclosure.core.api.enums.ProductTypeEnum@ARTIFACT.getType()} AND cargo.type = 2 AND cargo.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND DATE_FORMAT(cargo.create_time, '%Y') = DATE_FORMAT(#{dateTime}, '%Y') GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(cargo.create_time, '%Y-%m')

SELECT car_model model, COUNT(*) quantity FROM mes_enclosure_cargo_list WHERE `status` & 12 AND DATE_FORMAT(create_time,'%Y')=DATE_FORMAT(#{dateTime} , '%Y') AND shipment_status != ${@com.hzchum.scim.mes.enclosure.core.api.enums.cargoList.ShipmentStatusEnum@ABOLISH_DELIVERY.getType()} GROUP BY car_model ORDER BY car_model*1 ASC

SELECT project.id 'project.id', project.`name` 'project.name', project.short_name 'project.shortName', project.serial_number 'project.serialNumber', IFNULL(artifact.total_net_weight,0)total_net_weight, IFNULL(cargo.amount,0)cargo_amount, IFNULL(in_warehousing.amount,0)in_warehousing_amount, IFNULL(in_warehousing.amount-cargo.amount,0)stock FROM contract_project project LEFT JOIN ( SELECT project_id,sum(net_weight*quantity) total_net_weight FROM tech_artifact GROUP BY project_id )as artifact ON artifact.project_id=project.id LEFT JOIN( SELECT cargo.project_id, IFNULL( sum( cargo_link.quantity * artifact.net_weight ), 0 ) amount FROM mes_enclosure_cargo_list_product_link cargo_link LEFT JOIN tech_artifact artifact ON cargo_link.product_id = artifact.id LEFT JOIN mes_enclosure_cargo_list cargo ON cargo_link.cargo_list_id = cargo.id WHERE cargo_link.product_type = ${@com.hzchum.scim.mes.enclosure.core.api.enums.ProductTypeEnum@ARTIFACT.getType()} AND cargo_link.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND cargo.`status` & 12 GROUP BY cargo.project_id )as cargo ON cargo.project_id=project.id LEFT JOIN( SELECT cargo.project_id, IFNULL( sum( cargo.quantity * artifact.net_weight ), 0 ) amount FROM mes_enclosure_warehouse_summary cargo LEFT JOIN tech_artifact artifact ON cargo.product_id = artifact.id WHERE cargo.product_type = ${@com.hzchum.scim.mes.enclosure.core.api.enums.ProductTypeEnum@ARTIFACT.getType()} AND cargo.type = 1 AND cargo.bool_delete_enum = 0 GROUP BY cargo.project_id )as in_warehousing ON in_warehousing.project_id=project.id WHERE DATE_FORMAT(project.create_time,'%Y')= DATE_FORMAT(#{dateTime},'%Y') AND artifact.total_net_weight!=cargo.amount AND project.bool_delete_enum = 0 ORDER BY stock DESC

SELECT project.id 'project.id', project.`name` 'project.name', project.short_name 'project.short_name', project.serial_number 'project.serial_number', IFNULL(cargo.amount,0)cargo_amount, IFNULL(quantity_table.quantity,0)cargo_quantity FROM ( SELECT cargo.project_id, IFNULL( sum( cargo_link.quantity * artifact.net_weight ), 0 ) amount FROM mes_enclosure_cargo_list_product_link cargo_link LEFT JOIN tech_artifact artifact ON cargo_link.product_id = artifact.id LEFT JOIN mes_enclosure_cargo_list cargo ON cargo_link.cargo_list_id = cargo.id WHERE cargo_link.product_type = ${@com.hzchum.scim.mes.enclosure.core.api.enums.ProductTypeEnum@ARTIFACT.getType()} AND cargo_link.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND cargo.`status` & 12 AND date( cargo.audit_time )= date( #{dateTime} ) GROUP BY cargo.project_id ) AS cargo LEFT JOIN ( SELECT project_id, COUNT(*) quantity FROM mes_enclosure_cargo_list WHERE bool_delete_enum=0 and status & 12 AND date(audit_time )= date( #{dateTime} ) AND shipment_status != ${@com.hzchum.scim.mes.enclosure.core.api.enums.cargoList.ShipmentStatusEnum@ABOLISH_DELIVERY.getType()} GROUP BY project_id ) quantity_table ON quantity_table.project_id = cargo.project_id LEFT JOIN contract_project project ON cargo.project_id = project.id

select distinct cl.* FROM mes_enclosure_cargo_list AS cl INNER JOIN contract_project AS cp ON cl.project_id = cp.id AND cp.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND cp.business_type = 2
and cl.bool_delete_enum = 0 and cl.shipment_status != 2 and DATE_FORMAT(cl.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') >= #{startDate} and DATE_FORMAT(cl.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') <= #{endDate} and cl.project_id = #{projectId}
and cl.serial_number like concat('%',#{serialNumber},'%')
and cl.license_plate like concat('%',#{licensePlate},'%')
and cl.driver_name like concat('%',#{driverName},'%')
and cl.user_name like concat('%',#{userName},'%')
and cl.audit_user_name like concat('%',#{auditUserName},'%')
and (cl.receipt_name like concat('%',#{receiptName},'%') or cl.audit_receipt_name like concat('%',#{receiptName},'%'))
and cl.status & #{status} > 0
order by cl.status asc , cl.id desc

SELECT cp.id 'project.id', count( DISTINCT cargo.id ) cargoQuantity FROM mes_enclosure_cargo_list cargo LEFT JOIN contract_project cp ON cp.id=cargo.project_id WHERE cargo.product_type = 2 AND ( cargo.STATUS = 4 OR cargo.STATUS = 8 ) AND cargo.shipment_status != 2
AND DATE_FORMAT( cargo.create_time, '%Y/%m' ) = DATE_FORMAT(#{dateTime}, '%Y/%m')
AND cargo.project_id=#{projectId}
GROUP BY cp.id

SELECT DATE_FORMAT( a.create_time, '%Y-%m' ) date, IFNULL( sum( a.quantity * b.net_weight ), 0 ) cargoNetWeight, IFNULL( sum( a.quantity * b.gross_weight ), 0 ) cargoGrossWeight FROM mes_enclosure_warehouse_record a INNER JOIN tech_artifact b ON a.product_id = b.id AND b.bool_delete_enum = 0 WHERE a.product_type = 2 AND a.type = 2 AND a.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND DATE_FORMAT( a.create_time, '%Y' ) = DATE_FORMAT( #{dateTime}, '%Y' ) GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT( a.create_time, '%Y-%m' )
